concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 states: "The magnitude of the correlation coefficient (ρ) between gene expression and continuous metabolic traits is measured against the null hypothesis of no correlation (ρ = 0)." This description lacks a concrete, observable metric or threshold (e.g., a p‑value cutoff, confidence interval, or effect‑size benchmark) that can be automatically evaluated. As written, it is not directly measurable.
